mechanic.summary: A seeking orb fixates each player, repeatedly stacking damage and movement reduction until destroyed near a singularity.
mechanic.response: Use pings to assign singularities, then kite each orb within six yards of its assigned singularity without crossing teammates' paths.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Voidscar Arena guide and linked spell record.
